name: FitFul 13
summary: FitFul 13 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using moving average crossovers and momentum filters, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It employs a systematic approach with configurable parameters for period settings and risk management. The EA includes basic position management with stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: FitFul 13是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过均线交叉和动量过滤器识别市场方向，沿主趋势方向开仓交易。它采用系统化方法，提供可配置的周期参数和风险管理设置。该EA包含基于止损和止盈的基本仓位管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于移动平均线交叉来判断趋势方向，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生做多信号，下穿时产生做空信号。入场条件结合动量指标作为辅助过滤，确保仅在趋势动能充足时进场，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。出场条件包括固定的止损止盈比例，以及趋势反转信号出现时的主动平仓机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，但缺乏动态仓位调整算法。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制参数，但未实现整体组合风险控制或回撤保护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on moving average crossovers to determine trend direction, generating buy signals when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and sell signals on the reverse crossover. Entry conditions incorporate momentum indicators as auxiliary filters, ensuring trades are only opened when trend momentum is sufficient, which helps avoid frequent entries during ranging markets. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit ratios, along with an active position-closing mechanism when trend reversal signals appear. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-based calculation derived from account balance, though it lacks a dynamic position adjustment algorithm. Money management provides parameters for maximum position limits and per-trade risk control, but does not implement overall portfolio risk management or drawdown protection mechanisms.
pros: 趋势跟踪逻辑清晰易懂，参数可配置性强，适合不同市场环境调整
使用动量过滤减少震荡行情中的虚假信号，提高入场质量
包含止损止盈机制，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Clear and understandable trend-following logic with highly configurable parameters suitable for different market conditions
Uses momentum filtering to reduce false signals in ranging markets, improving entry quality
Includes stop loss and take profit mechanisms providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 缺乏高级资金管理机制如动态仓位调整和最大回撤保护
均线交叉策略 inherent 滞后性导致入场偏晚，可能错过趋势初期的大段利润
未包含点差过滤和市场时段过滤，在高点差时段可能产生不利成交
cons_en: Lacks advanced money management mechanisms such as dynamic position sizing and maximum drawdown protection
Moving average crossover strategies have inherent lag causing late entries, potentially missing significant profit from the early trend phase
Does not include spread filtering or trading session filtering, which may result in unfavorable fills during high-spread periods
improvements: 增加自适应均线周期或动态参数优化机制，减少滞后性影响
添加最大回撤保护和日内交易时段过滤器，提升风险控制能力
improvements_en: Add adaptive MA periods or dynamic parameter optimization mechanisms to reduce the impact of lag
Implement maximum drawdown protection and intraday trading session filters to enhance risk control capabilities

risk_points: 均线滞后可能导致止损被触发后趋势才真正展开，造成不必要的亏损
缺乏点差和滑点过滤，在流动性不足时段交易成本可能过高
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能频繁止损
risk_points_en: MA lag may cause stop losses to be triggered before the trend actually unfolds, resulting in unnecessary losses
Lack of spread and slippage filtering may lead to excessively high trading costs during low-liquidity periods
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility changes, potentially causing frequent stops during high-volatility periods
